host_requirements.requirement: Declare one opam switch and lock its package sources and versions. Include Coq, Iris, Lithium, stdpp, stdpp-bitvector, isla-lang, Islaris, OCaml, and Dune.
host_requirements.observed: The opam package metadata reports coq/coq-core 8.19.0. Both opam exec coqc --version and the explicit switch coqc report 8.19.2+lsp, compiled with OCaml 4.14.4. The switch reports Dune 3.23.1, Iris dev.2024-09-10.1.6f24ed4b, Lithium dev.2024-09-11.0.7945a29d, stdpp and stdpp-bitvector dev.2024-09-10.3.a1a12e00.
host_requirements.gap: The package version is a metadata label for a pinned LSP fork. The executable agrees with MCP health. The local Islaris opam file requires Dune >=3.10.0 and <3.11.0, unlike the installed Dune. A complete environment lock remains absent. This report selects no new host pin.

host_requirements.requirement: Declare Sail/libsail 0.17 and a compatible OCaml/Dune environment. Build the tracked plugin sources before the adapter.
host_requirements.observed: tools/stock_zisk/platform/build.py invokes /home/cody/islaris explicitly. The plugin is tracked in build/stock-zisk/platform/sail_plugin_isla.cmxs.
host_requirements.gap: The recipe records executable hashes, but no complete opam lock or relocatable switch path.
